responsibility: Implements GCC’s AutoFDO profile-use pipeline for sampled profiles. This file reads AFDO data from gcov-style input records into function/string/source-profile structures, performs the early inline and indirect-call promotion loop needed to make GIMPLE/cgraph resemble the profiled binary, then annotates CFG basic blocks and edges with profile_count/count and branch probability information before recomputing function frequencies and summaries. It also owns the IPA pass entry point, AutoFDO file lifecycle helpers, and the hot-callsite query used by early inlining decisions.
same_name_distinction: This is the AutoFDO implementation file: it defines the sampled-profile reader, CFG annotation logic, early inline/value-profile iteration, and the IPA pass body. Unlike gcc/auto-profile.h, which only exposes a tiny interface, this .cc owns the executable AutoFDO machinery and pass execution.
